name: Signal Jammer - DMG UP
RelatedDescription: Unceasingly emits EM waves to suppressively interfere with projectiles and disrupt electronic equipment, thus weakening the power of tactical weapons. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's DMG UP capability.

61178.SpecificEffects:
